_comment: Fill in the real URLs for each environment. frontendUrl = Vercel deploy URL (becomes the App/OAuth homepage). apiUrl = Render service URL (becomes the GitHub App webhook host). supabaseRef = the Supabase project ref for that environment (the xxxx in https://xxxx.supabase.co) — the OAuth callback is https://<supabaseRef>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback.
